parsed.why: No facility ban in force; restroom use unprotected but lawful; hate-crime enhancement exists. Licence-marker ban is resident-facing. Division roughly parent-level, mildly worse on documents, better on facilities.

March 2025 statute imposes birth-sex facilities rule across bathrooms, shelters, dorms, prisons — universal exposure. Religious-refusal statute permits service denial with immunity; no statewide non-discrimination. Adds tier-1 exposure above parent.

February 2026 law: birth-sex facility rule in public buildings including airports, $1,000 penalty, private bounty lawsuits, licence invalidation. Rated 'Do Not Travel.' Universal exposure with public enforcement mechanism — clearly below parent.

Assessed low-risk group; governor vetoed bathroom and pronoun bills; employment and municipal protections, no adult-targeting. National passport/entry regime still applies; Pride dissolution and youth policies cap the lift above parent.

July 2026 law criminalises birth-sex facility use in government buildings AND private businesses — restaurants, gas stations, hospitals — misdemeanour up to a year. Broadest universal exposure; no effective remedy yet.
